## Current physical publication histories through class events

Updated: 2026-10-19 13:31 CEST. Proof checkpoint: `bf90e5e3e`.
Verified start: `54edece9c`. Source main remains `184bba662`.
Read `lean/notes-current-event-publication-history.md`.
Actual stored unfolds, Required reads, Head, projections, comparison
selection and memo Merge now derive their physical publication intervals.
Actual parent edits and chronological class folds compose those intervals
at their exact returned heaps. Initial original-value availability stays
explicit. No publication history is inferred from heap growth.

A selected event retains its same actual native or Head execution heap.
Under the stated support and supplied initial publication history, that
heap has both the initial prefix and the suffix into the final fold heap.
Later extensions require an actual publication interval plus Keeps.
Native memo history stays separate. An empty initial prefix allows the
existing stored-writer theorem to recover actual source publications.
This does not derive the complete outer startup or scan chronology.

It does not exercise a complete class fold or outer reduction.

callback. Binding ancestry, renewal bounds, active-owner exclusion,
outer completion, convergence and Haskell correspondence remain open.

# Actual publication histories through class events

Checked: 2026-10-19. Proof checkpoint: `bf90e5e3e`.
Verified start: `54edece9c`. Source main: `184bba662`.
Evidence: `restart-evidence/20261019-event-publication-history/`.

This checkpoint derives physical Mu publication intervals from actual
completed lower operations. It supplies these intervals at the same
captured event heap as the existing native or Head execution receipt.
It does not infer publication history from heap growth or native history.

## Actual lower operations

`SourceCurrentRequiredPublicationHistory` derives histories through actual
stored unfolding, row reads, Head, ordered reads and unions, selected
path and forest projections, and Required node, child and row calls.
The graph producers require SemanticReady, CostHeap and input availability.
They cover successful open and closed inputs. Stored unfolding also
covers its pending outcome. Each Mu reconstruction uses its actual source
construction history. Ordinary constructors use their exact NoNewMu law.

`SourceCurrentMergePublicationHistory` follows the actual Merge graph.
Its comparison selection follows real short-circuit row reads and child
comparisons. A private constructor-work law is proved for actual Merge
code. It is not assumed for arbitrary work jobs. The allocated producer
uses the actual receipt, initial semantic and cost facts, stored Merge
memo values and available input. No output-language premise is used.

`SourceCurrentParentPublicationHistory` composes projection, Merge and
native query histories through actual operands, targets, Force and leaves.
Node, child, row and list producers follow actual parent edit reads.
They retain the original forest's availability at its captured base heap.
Keeps transports that availability. It does not supply publication history.

`SourceCurrentClassPublicationHistory` derives the exact interval of a
supported actual class, completed chronological right fold, or class pass.
The tail's actual return supplies the next class entry. The existing Fold
receipt derives its support. There is no future enclosing-return premise.

## The same captured event heap

`SourceCurrentClassEventPublications.Source` retains one eventHeap with
SemanticReady, CostHeap, available event and Keeps into its reader heap.
It adds both `History initialHeap eventHeap` and
`History eventHeap readerHeap` to that same existential. Its native or
Head execution payload remains the exact earlier supported payload.
`Source.forget` projects to the older event receipt.
`Source.later` requires both Keeps and an actual publication interval.

Actual node and child producers require original-value availability at
the captured base heap, their existing supported read premises, native
history at the entry, and a physical publication prefix into that entry.
Actual operation histories derive both sides of the selected event.
The initial prefix is explicit. It is not derived from native history.

`SourceCurrentClassFoldEventPublications.fold` consumes actual FoldReads
and a selected FoldEvent. It derives that stronger Source receipt.
For a head event, the actual tail supplies the publication prefix.
For an earlier tail event, the actual head supplies its later suffix.
Actual worker determinism aligns the proof-indexed intermediate states.

The caller can use `SourceCurrentNativeMuPublication.closed_history`
for a literal closed construction from the empty source heap. With an
actual empty-to-event history, the existing `History.from_empty` theorem
recovers a real earlier publication for each stored Mu at that event heap.
This checkpoint does not derive every intervening outer startup and scan
operation. It does not transport an issued-allocation Path through an
arbitrary physical trace. Native cells and memo history remain at their
captured checked reader. A later physical Origin view stays separate.

## Constructed check and verification

The constructed check builds a used outer Mu with a used inner Mu.
The inner source captures the outer local name. Actual Head exposure
rebuilds the inner Mu with the outer Mu value. Its completed record is
absent before exposure and present afterward. The heaps differ.
The actual read and Head producers derive local publication histories.
The initial closed history then derives a publication writer from empty.
The original construction's issued Path is derived separately.
The check exercises no full class fold or outer reduction.

Thirty production public declarations and one constructed declaration
pass complete statement, proof and standard-axiom checks. All eight
printer settings are retained. The checks reject omitted proof text and
nonstandard axioms. Six production strict logs and the constructed strict
log are empty. Earlier failed attempts remain in immutable evidence.

The root personally observed the full default build handle reach exit
code zero. It passes 3468 jobs and checks 73931 axiom dependencies.
Its sole warning remains the earlier unused `inputs` at
`InternedFreshOrdinaryClosedCompletion:24:5`.
Heavy jobs use the required memory cap. Effective memory.max and
memory.high are 4294967296 bytes. Effective memory.swap.max is zero.

The selected stored Mu body and the current compiler callback can differ.
An actual publication writer supplies provenance for the stored value.
It does not identify those two bodies. The next step is selected guarded
row and child readback for that stored winner, including lexical backedges.
Reference binding ancestry and a global recursive renewal bound remain
open. General active-owner exclusion, outer completion, repeated-pass
convergence and concrete Haskell correspondence remain open.

The conditional root-language guarantee is unchanged. All 268 Haskell
files and all 207 active package files retain their bytes. No local Haskell
repair or Haskell validation result is added. FINDINGS keeps every earlier
repair first. The upstream ordered cursor, template, subsumption and new
adapter paths still need implementation proofs. The full-library goal
remains active. Publication awaits direct approval.

In simple technical English: fresh construction always finishes in the
Lean model. Under the stated guard conditions, its result represents
exactly the finite trees specified by its expression. A completed supported
modeled root reduction with empty inherited constraints preserves that
exact language.
The root theorem derives the logical startup cache and guard facts.
Field allocation, validity, guard coverage and numeric resources remain
explicit. General termination and Haskell correspondence remain open.

on both sides of the same captured event heap. The caller supplies the
initial publication prefix and the stated original capture availability.
Actual Required, projection, Merge and parent operations derive the later
intervals. Heap growth and native memo history supply no such history.
This is a provenance prerequisite. Selected stored-body readback, binding
ancestry and a general renewal bound remain open.
